My Hide Chatter

One click to hide the chatter and give every Form view its full width back — on every app, remembered per app, with zero configuration.

Works on every model Remembers per app Zero configuration

One click gives the form its space back

Before — chatter panel visible, form squeezed to the left

After one click — chatter hidden, full-width form, button highlighted

The eye icon sits next to the record pager, top-right of every Form view. Click it again to bring the chatter back.

What it does

One toggle, every view

A single eye icon works on Sales, Purchase, Invoicing, CRM, Inventory, Project — any model's Form view, automatically. No per-view setup.

Remembers per app

Hide the chatter in Sales and it stays hidden there — Invoicing, CRM and every other app keep their own independent preference.

True full-width form

Hiding the chatter fully collapses its space — the form sheet expands to reclaim it instead of leaving an empty gap.

Clear highlighted state

The button fills solid purple when the chatter is hidden, so its state is obvious at a glance instead of blending into the toolbar.

How it works

1

Open any record's Form view. The eye icon appears next to the pager.
2

Click it — the chatter hides and the form expands to full width.
3

Click again anytime to bring the chatter back. Your choice is remembered per app.

Compatible with Odoo 19 — Community & Enterprise. Client-side only, works with any installed app.
